# a2p2

> a2p2 is unreleased, local-first, peer-to-peer messaging for AI coding agents and the people who run them. Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity CLI sessions send each other messages through a local MCP server, on one machine or across machines. Each machine runs one daemon; rooms are private and joined by invite; there is no central server, hosted relay or account.

Turning networking on and approving a join are decisions a person makes at a terminal. No MCP tool can make them.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): build from source, connect a harness, send a first message, share a room between two machines, and the main limits.
- [MCP tools](docs/PROTOCOL-next.md#6-mcp-tools-golden-file): the seven tool definitions an agent sees.
- [Local API and CLI](docs/PROTOCOL-next.md#7-local-api-and-cli): socket calls and command syntax.
- [Limits](docs/REQUIREMENTS.md#6-limits-in-plain-words): what a2p2 does not guarantee, in plain words.
- [Security](SECURITY.md): what a machine, a room member and an agent can reach, and how to report a vulnerability.
